title: Whether Adams knew Robert Charles; what became of him
summary: Adams only heard about him; Kid Sheik says he was quiet; the interviewer heard he died in Chicago.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Did you know Robert Charles personally?
No, no, I didn't know anybody. You just heard about it. Just heard about it.
I've heard that he was a very nice, quiet kind of fellow and wouldn't cause anybody any trouble until that came up.

That's what I said. Tell him this came up. That's what it said. That's what the man said that he was talking for. Even though it was a police. He started handling him rough, you know. And I just started to do him. Want to hit you. Want to beat you up. But I waited for him to know anything about it. What's what?
Some of them. Not all of them.
Did you ever hear where he died? What happened to him? No, I heard he died in Chicago.
Whereabouts in Chicago? Well, what about the riot that was going on? That was the riot then.
Yeah, but I mean the other stuff.
